killedBy: live status announcements (issue #629) stays SILENT about the level while an outcome surface is up
why: Announces the new level even while an outcome surface is up. That is criterion 5's double-announcement exactly: the win panel is focused and read aloud at the same moment the next mission number arrives, so the player hears the level twice -- once from the panel they are on, once from a live region talking over it. Gated on the panel's own `outcomeVisible` rather than on a delay, so this is a state check a mutation can break and a test can see.
